bundle.shortDescription: Quick trim, crop and speed edits for video clips
bundle.longDescription: FlipperClipper is a lightweight video editor for fast edits before sending a clip to someone: trim the length, crop the frame, change the speed and mute the audio, then export to MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM or GIF, or pull the audio out on its own.
